jessica sevier.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Jessica Sevier blends country, roots and Americana with rock energy and R&B touches in a growing independent Canadian catalogue.

jessica sole.bio: Shelburne, Ontario singer-songwriter Jessica Sole is a Canadian country artist known for polished contemporary production, melodic hooks and an independent career built through radio and live performance.

jill barber.bio: Ontario-born singer-songwriter Jill Barber is a Canadian folk, jazz and pop artist whose English- and French-language recordings have built a long international career.

jocelyn alice.bio: Calgary-born singer-songwriter Jocelyn Alice is a Canadian pop artist whose solo breakthrough came with the platinum-certified single Jackpot after earlier work in the duo Jocelyn & Lisa.

johnny orlando.bio: Mississauga-born singer-songwriter Johnny Orlando is a Canadian pop artist who built an early online following before developing a major-label recording and international touring career.

johnny reid.bio: Scottish-born Canadian country and soul singer Johnny Reid grew up in Brampton and built a multi-platinum career around raspy vocals, rootsy songwriting and arena-scale live shows.

josh ramsay.bio: Vancouver singer, songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Josh Ramsay is best known as the frontman of Marianas Trench and as a co-writer and producer on major Canadian pop records.

julie doiron.bio: Moncton-born Acadian singer-songwriter Julie Doiron is a Canadian indie-rock and folk artist known for her solo catalogue and her long-running role in Eric's Trip.

july talk.bio: Toronto band July Talk is a Canadian alternative-rock group known for the contrasting vocals of Leah Fay and Peter Dreimanis, visceral live shows and a Juno-winning catalogue.

junkhouse.bio: Hamilton band Junkhouse is a Canadian alternative-rock group formed by Tom Wilson whose 1990s catalogue produced a run of nationally successful rock-radio singles.

justin nozuka.bio: American-born, Toronto-raised singer-songwriter Justin Nozuka is a Canadian-American artist whose intimate catalogue blends folk, soul, R&B and acoustic songwriting.

kalsey kulyk.bio: Hudson Bay, Saskatchewan singer-songwriter Kalsey Kulyk is a Canadian country artist whose contemporary recordings draw on traditional country storytelling and prairie roots.

karim ouellet.bio: Dakar-born, Québec-raised singer-songwriter Karim Ouellet was a Senegalese-Canadian artist whose French-language pop blended soul, reggae, rock and electronic influences.

karl wolf.bio: Lebanese-born Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Karl Wolf built a Toronto-based pop and R&B career known for polished crossover production and international radio singles.

katie tupper.bio: Saskatoon singer-songwriter Katie Tupper is a Canadian soul and R&B artist known for warm vocals, understated grooves and intimate contemporary songwriting.

kelsi mayne.bio: Windsor, Ontario singer-songwriter Kelsi Mayne is a Canadian country artist whose genre-blending sound mixes country roots with rock, soul and pop influences.

kim stockwood.bio: St. John's-born singer-songwriter Kim Stockwood is a Canadian pop and roots artist whose career includes solo hits, songwriting, radio work and membership in the trio Shaye.

kimmortal.bio: Vancouver-based Filipino-Canadian musician and visual artist Kimmortal blends hip-hop, R&B, soul and experimental music with queer and diasporic storytelling.

kiwi jr..bio: Toronto-based band Kiwi Jr. is a Canadian indie-rock group known for jangly guitars, literate lyrics and sharp power-pop songwriting.

kristina maria.bio: Ottawa-born singer-songwriter Kristina Maria is a Canadian pop and R&B artist whose early-2010s catalogue combined dance-pop production with melodic radio songwriting.

la sécurité.bio: Montréal art-punk collective La Sécurité makes wiry Canadian post-punk built around jumpy rhythms, minimal hooks and playful, danceable arrangements.

lex leosis.bio: Toronto-born rapper Lex Leosis is a Canadian hip-hop artist known for dynamic flows, storytelling and her earlier work in the all-women rap collective The Sorority.

linda carvery.bio: Halifax singer Linda Carvery is an African Nova Scotian jazz and gospel vocalist whose career spans recording, theatre, community leadership and arts advocacy.

loreena mckennitt.bio: Manitoba-born singer, composer and producer Loreena McKennitt is a Canadian music icon whose self-produced catalogue blends Celtic, folk and world-music traditions.

louis-jean cormier.bio: Québec singer-songwriter, guitarist and producer Louis-Jean Cormier is a French-Canadian artist known for his solo catalogue and his work with the band Karkwa.

lølø.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter LØLØ is a Canadian pop-rock and pop-punk artist known for confessional lyrics, sharp hooks and an online audience that helped launch her international career.

majical cloudz.bio: Montréal duo Majical Cloudz was a Canadian electronic art-pop project led by Devon Welsh and Matthew Otto, known for sparse arrangements and intensely direct songwriting.

maren ord.bio: Edmonton-born singer-songwriter Maren Ord is a Canadian pop and rock artist whose early-2000s career included national radio success and a Juno nomination for Best New Artist.

massari.bio: Lebanese-born Canadian singer-songwriter Massari built an Ottawa-rooted R&B and pop career around melodic vocals, Middle Eastern influence and international crossover singles.

mastermind.bio: Toronto DJ, broadcaster and programmer Mastermind, born Paul Parhar, is a foundational Canadian hip-hop curator whose mixtapes and radio work helped document and promote the country's rap scene.

mathematik.bio: Toronto rapper, producer and DJ Mathematik, born Lyndon Dash, is a Canadian underground hip-hop artist known for jazz-inflected production, conscious lyricism and his connection to Down Ta Erf.

matt mays.bio: Nova Scotia singer-songwriter Matt Mays is a Canadian rock artist whose solo work and recordings with El Torpedo blend heartland rock, alternative rock and expansive guitar-driven songwriting.

matthew good band.bio: Vancouver group Matthew Good Band was a Canadian alternative-rock band whose late-1990s and early-2000s albums became major commercial and radio successes in Canada.

melanie doane.bio: Nova Scotia-born singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Melanie Doane is a Juno-winning Canadian pop-rock artist whose career also spans theatre, television and music education.

mia martina.bio: New Brunswick-born singer-songwriter Mia Martina is a Canadian dance-pop artist known for bilingual vocals, club-oriented production and a run of Juno-nominated singles.

mobile.bio: Montréal band Mobile is a Canadian alternative-rock group whose debut album Tomorrow Starts Today earned major radio play and the Juno Award for New Group of the Year.

mood ruff.bio: Winnipeg group Mood Ruff was a pioneering Canadian hip-hop act known for socially conscious lyricism, grassroots touring and an important role in Manitoba's independent rap scene.
